steps.title: Analyze and identify crash causes
steps.description: Examine the runtime behavior under Android 14 (API 34) which enforces export flags on BroadcastReceivers and strict foreground service declarations.

steps.title: Modify dynamic BroadcastReceiver registration
steps.description: Implement explicit Context.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED flags for SDK >= 33 to prevent SecurityException crashes on startup.

steps.title: Update Foreground Service type declaration
steps.description: Define ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK in startForeground for API level 29+ to satisfy modern Android target SDK 34 rules.

steps.title: Clean build dependencies in build.gradle
steps.description: Remove the unused external nanohttpd library from app/build.gradle to comply with pure-SDK rules and avoid compilation bloating.

steps.title: Fortify Media Query scan results
steps.description: Enhance cursor data lookup in scanLocalSongs to protect against -1 column indices and invalid media items on modern devices.

steps.title: Verify UI lifecycle safety for progress dialogs
steps.description: Add isFinishing() and isDestroyed() guards before manipulating the ProgressDialog instances on background thread completion.

steps.title: Add exception handling wrapper for broadcast unregistration
steps.description: Protect unregisterReceiver dynamic calls with try-catch blocks to prevent crashes on abnormal app exits.

steps.title: Double-check Manifest namespaces and configuration
steps.description: Verify system-wide settings, permissions, and service declarations remain completely standard.

steps.title: Verify metadata synchronization under app-meta.json
steps.description: Confirm metadata consistency is correctly established across all configuration files.

steps.title: Building Harmony Player
steps.description: Assemble debug compilation to produce the safe, crash-free APK target.
